purpose: Bind each fresh flow to buyer money, provider cost/availability, acceptance and operator spread. Kill or downgrade flows where the observed market already owns the routing layer or where compatible unit economics cannot be bound.

results.name: Local commercial content micro-orders

buyer_unit.task: Remote short-video packaging/editing; project basis; roughly one workday; ongoing 1-2 videos per week.

provider_unit.provider_profile: 5-year video editor offering short-video/口播/e-commerce editing

economics.warning: This is gross spread only, before platform fees, tax, coordination time, failed delivery/rework and customer acquisition.

acceptance.buyer_side: One fast-packaged Douyin short-video project; detailed acceptance standard not publicly bound.

operator_edge_audit.reason: The buyer is already using a mature freelancer marketplace and has dozens of direct applicants. Re-inserting another matcher does not yet show durable incremental value.

results.rationale: Price spread exists, but the exact observed transaction already has a mature matching rail. The spread proves the work unit can be routed, not that our operator layer is needed.

results.name: SME AI / office-workflow micro-project routing

buyer_unit.task: Lightweight AI application projects: agents, knowledge bases, Dify/n8n/Coze integrations, RPA, data sync, reports, CRM and APIs.
buyer_unit.evidence_note: The observed buyer-side actor is itself a project-coordination company recruiting developers and routing projects.

examples.fact: Independent provider offers enterprise AI apps/agents/knowledge bases/automation workflows with a very broad 200-20,000 RMB range.
Current remote AI application interns/part-time developers can be found at 200-300 RMB/day, but this does not prove they can independently deliver the same 5,000 RMB project specification.

economics.reason: No independent provider quote was found for the same scoped deliverable at a known lower cost. Skill/scope compatibility is unresolved.

operator_edge_audit.reason: The observed 5,000-RMB-per-project actor already performs project coordination, quoting and developer routing. Adding our layer would duplicate an existing intermediary.

results.revival_condition: Only reopen with a direct SME buyer outside an existing AI agency/platform plus a compatible independent implementer quote for the same bounded acceptance tests.

results.name: Local-presence field microtasks

task: attend ASE China 2026 in Shanghai for one day

evidence.fact: The buyer post itself received multiple willing applicants, including a former foreign-trade salesperson with flooring/exhibition experience and a civil-engineering master's student.
Current Shanghai exhibition English-assistance labor is advertised around 280 RMB/day for simple English-capable event work.
A current Shanghai brand field-research project pays project assistants about 350 RMB/day for in-person store contact/research support.

current_same_city_supply.provider: Shanghai bilingual onsite assistant on Fiverr
current_same_city_supply.scope: short offline Shanghai field task, maximum 4 working hours onsite; photo/video verification and simple offline errands available
current_same_city_supply.note: Public price proves same-city paid execution supply, but does not quote the 21-shop survey scope.

current_same_city_supply.fact: Current platforms maintain flexible paid evaluators for retail/store visits and evidence-based reports.
current_same_city_supply.note: Project-specific pay is not public, so this is availability infrastructure rather than a compatible quote.

economics.warning: This is not a provider-specific quote for the expired buyer task. It is a market-cost window. Travel, briefing, QA, payment, failure replacement and acquisition costs are not included.

acceptance.shape: Predefined checklist + required manufacturer information + photos/cards/catalogues + short post-event summary by deadline.

direct_evidence: Buyer explicitly asked where to find a reliable local person.
A commenter noted the high applicant volume itself creates a screening problem.

results.blocker: Bind one or more independent Shanghai executor quotes/availability signals for the exact 21-shop task or an equivalent route/time specification before claiming margin.

task: take shelf photos with readable wine labels
live_buyer_search.acceptance: Complete and satisfactory photo report per shop; labels must be clearly readable.

competition_signal.note: A mature marketplace already exposes the task to direct freelancers; operator value must be more than introduction.

live_buyer_search.evidence_warning: The page was posted yesterday/two days ago and exposes current proposal activity, but also shows an obviously inconsistent deadline of Nov 17, 2025. Treat deadline as UNKNOWN until confirmed; do not silently correct it.

economics_live_unit.reason: A public Shanghai provider price exists for a 4-hour field block, but no independent full-scope quote for 21 wine shops is bound. Do not multiply or extrapolate without route/time evidence.

key_learning: A visible price spread is not enough; the operator must own a missing edge that current buyer/provider channels do not already solve.
CSVF-001 proves routable unit economics but not operator necessity because a mature freelancer marketplace already owns matching for the observed buyer.
CSVF-002 fails the current unit test because the observed buyer is itself an intermediary and compatible provider economics are not bound.

CSVF-003 best matches the original business logic: buyer cannot easily access local presence, local capable people exist, the task is checklist-bounded, acceptance is explicit, and the buyer visibly experiences a search/screening friction.

The next search should not broaden into generic errands. It should search fresh current cross-geography tasks where remote buyers need local presence, evidence collection or bounded commercial legwork and where the work is safe, lawful and non-regulated.
A live buyer task is now bound for CSVF-003, but truthful margin still requires a same-scope executor quote; generic day rates must not be extrapolated into a 21-shop cost.
